newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close down amid selling pressure.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close down amid selling pressure.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed down for a fourth straight session on Monday amid selling pressure set off by recent new regulations, but brokers were optimistic of the market returning to stability soon.
The Dhaka Stock exchange benchmark index fell 1.09 percent or 19.86 points at 1,793.58 on a turnover of 138.1 million taka. Of the 96 issues traded, 67 closed up and 29 ended down.

"Selling pressure has weakened and many good scrips have gained. The market is stabilising," said one broker. Aziz Pipes lost 233 taka to 2.092, Chittagong Cement rose 219.93 to 4,251.35 and Apex Foods fell 418.33 to 8,781.
